تستفهموا (form X)
# تَسْتَفْهِمُوا (tastafhimū) /tas.taf.hi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# تُسْتَفْهَمُوا (tustafhamū) /tus.taf.ha.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
